text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Um, Universe-san, do you have any interest 
in soccer?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Soccer...? With Argos, "training", I have 
done.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, would you care to join in? 
I was invited to an intrasquad match next 
weekend, but we're still short on players.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"...! But Neo Universe is... outside of 
"providence," you know...?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Outside of "providence"... Um, does that 
mean you have no racing experience...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That is not the case at all. If you are 
feeling anxious, would you like to 
practice with me before the intrasquad 
match?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"...Is it... really okay? ...In that 
case... maybe I will 'give it my all.'"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: I will 'strive' a lot, and do my 'best'.
